## Standing operator rules
Never set a Cloud Run minimum instance count above zero; store the approved warm-capacity exception in infra/cost-exceptions.yaml with an owner and expiry date.

Never edit `grafana/ledgerly-billing-v3.json` without first posting the proposed dashboard change in `#obs-dashboard` for `@mina` to review.

Run the `redis-dual-write-cutover` procedure in the specified order, one step at a time.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Current objective
Fix Quebec (QST) tax calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`; OpenTelemetry tracing is paused/superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Positive-only filtering discarded negative credits; omit only zero amounts.
- `page_height - 54` caused three-page invoices; use `page_height - 36`.
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours hid stuck jobs; do not retry.

## Recent work
Cutover steps 3–5 succeeded: service installed/restarted, 8,421,639 keys scanned/backfilled, and reconciliation found zero differences. Lint and full tests pass (149 passed, 2 skipped). Logging was partially improved, but unrelated work should stop while the QST fix is completed.
